description: Manages user permissions and role-based access control within the system.

endpoints.name: GetSystemPermissionConfiguration
endpoints.description: Retrieves the complete system permission configuration, including all roles and their associated capabilities.
endpoints.when_to_use: When needing to initialize the frontend with the system's permission settings.

endpoints.name: CheckUserRoutePermission
endpoints.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access a specific route or page.
example_uses: Check if the user can access a specific route.
Verify user permissions for a given URL.
endpoints.when_to_use: When needing to determine if the current user has access to a particular route.

endpoints.name: GetEntityPermissionDetails
endpoints.description: Retrieves detailed permission information for a specific entity, including all possible operations and role requirements.
example_uses: Get permission details for a specific entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: When needing to understand the permission structure for a particular entity.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentUserRoles
endpoints.description: Retrieves the roles and permissions of the currently authenticated user.
endpoints.when_to_use: When needing to know the roles and permissions of the current user.

endpoints.name: GetUserRolesByUserId
endpoints.description: Retrieves the roles and basic information for a specific user, identified by their user ID.
example_uses: Get roles for a specific user.
Retrieve user roles by user ID.
endpoints.when_to_use: When needing to know the roles of a specific user, typically for administrative purposes.

endpoints.name: GetAvailableSystemRoles
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all available system roles and their descriptions.
example_uses: Get a list of available system roles.
Retrieve all possible roles in the system.
endpoints.when_to_use: When needing to know the available roles within the system.
